action: @Bubbles gently accepts @GoldenStar from @Lulu with both small side flippers, hugs it against the front and gives one shy but determined nod. @Lulu releases only once the star is secure.
camera: 50mm medium two-shot, other friends behind and softly readable.
audio: @Bubbles, soft airy high ghost voice, 1-2s: {I can try!} A tiny airy flutter.

action: @Bubbles rises briskly three body heights above the garden, passing the curved tree’s lower canopy in regular real-time motion, the star snug against the body. Camera tilts upward with the ascent. @Bubbles looks upward at the huge distant sky and reaches a flipper out, but stays far below the clouds.
camera: 35mm vertical follow at normal speed; ground friends remain small in lower frame.
audio: Quick rising airy swoosh. @Bubbles, 5-7s: {Oh... still too far.}
end_state: @Bubbles at modest height near tree crown.

action: @Bubbles descends promptly and safely to the same clearing with the star. The other four step in, relieved. @Pip notices the peach horizon and points.
camera: Hard cut to 50mm eye-level garden group, boulder left and tree right.
audio: @Pip, 8-10s: {The sun is setting!} Subtle urgent pizzicato pickup.
end_state: @Bubbles returns, all five beside the star.

action: @Lulu perks up with a clear idea, touches the chest, then opens both paws toward the friends. @Bubbles lowers the star toward the moss. Finish with a one-second attentive reaction.
camera: Hard cut to 65mm @Lulu close-up, gray side pads and flower cheeks visible.
audio: One small hopeful music chime. No new words.
end_state: @Lulu ready to suggest a shared wish.
